answer: SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000;

WITH consumption_2013 AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM consumption_2013
  GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT sm.Segment, sm.min_consumption / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
  FROM consumption_2013 c
  JOIN seg_min sm ON c.Segment = sm.Segment AND c.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
  GROUP BY sm.Segment, sm.min_consumption
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='LAM') AS sme_minus_lam,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='KAM') AS lam_minus_kam,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='SME') AS kam_minus_sme;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment='SME' AND Currency='CZK') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment='SME' AND Currency='EUR') AS more_czk_than_eur;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency='EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS pct_eur_customers FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE t.Date BETWEEN '2013-06-01' AND '2013-06-30';
note: Query is well-formed and correct against the given schema, but transactions_1k only contains dates 2012-08-23 through 2012-08-26 (confirmed via MIN/MAX(Date)), so no rows exist for June 2013 and the result set is genuinely empty.
